name: Recup Artisanal
description: Parmi les débris de la Ceinture, Recup Artisanal récupère les débris précieux, maîtrise la furtivité spatiale, arme un fusil de récupération, manie une torche de soudure, ambiance grimdark des astéroïdes. Son armure bricolée et son furtivité lui permettent d'opérer là où les grandes factions échouent, dans l'ombre des astéroïdes.

loadout.armor_outfit: Improvised, heavily patched mining exosuit made of welded rusted steel plates, duct‑taped joints, exposed cables, and scavenged signage; asymmetric, overloaded with tool pouches, carabiners, and cables; helmet: cracked welding mask with opaque scratched visor; reinforced gloves with magnetic grips; patched pressure suit with burnt patches and patched seams.
loadout.arsenal: Improvised kinetic harpoon rifle with exposed copper coils, a jury‑rigged plasma torch welded onto a mining pick, a kinetic impact hammer with a battery pack taped to its side, and a set of magnetic debris nets for catching floating scrap.

attitude.behavior: Combat stance: low‑gravity crouch, one leg braced on a floating slab, weapon raised, torso twisted toward the threat, eyes focused, muscles coiled, ready to launch.
attitude.emotion: Intense, adrenaline‑fueled focus, a fierce grin of a battle‑hardened scavenger, eyes narrowed under the visor, a mixture of fury and calculation.

palette_names.name: Rusted Steel
palette_names.role: Primary structural color, dominant metal surfaces

palette_names.name: Orange Rust
palette_names.role: Secondary accents, oxidized panels, heat tint

palette_names.name: Blue Plasma
palette_names.role: Energy accent, glowing torch, sparks, plasma vents

palette_names.name: Molten Orange
palette_names.role: Molten metal rivers, fire glow, hot metal

palette_names.name: Spark Yellow‑White
palette_names.role: Sparks and bright flashes from clashing weapons

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic low‑key key light from a distant plasma furnace, strong rim lighting from molten metal streams, volumetric blue plasma glow, high‑contrast fill from sparks and floating debris, subtle ambient bounce from asteroid walls.

camera.angle: Low‑angle dutch tilt, dynamic, slight upward tilt to emphasize looming structures and floating debris

scenography.setting: Interior of a hollowed asteroid turned into a massive scrapyard battlefield: massive, half‑collapsed spacecraft hulls, towering cargo containers, exposed structural beams, ruptured tanks spilling molten metal rivers, floating debris clouds, improvised barricades of welded scrap, low‑gravity environment.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Falling debris, slow‑moving floating metal chunks, cascading molten metal streams, dense clouds of grinding sparks, flickering plasma torch flames, dust and smoke, occasional bursts of blue energy from improvised weapons, faint gravity distortion effects.
